title: S07T01 - Define extension manifest, identity, permissions, dependencies, and compatibility
description: Publish a schema for extension identity, versions, required Boreal ranges, assets, permissions, dependencies, conflicts, signatures, and lifecycle hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Extensions declare every file root, command family, workflow, validator, adapter, and network or process permission they require.
Install refuses unsigned or incompatible packages according to explicit policy and reports dependency or permission conflicts before writing.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
